Boost.JSON.version_evidence: boost/version.hpp BOOST_VERSION 109200; libs/json/CHANGELOG.adoc lists Boost 1.92.0 first
Boost.JSON.note: Official Boost 1.92.0 release archive. Boost.JSON has no separate release; its version is the Boost release. Only boost/json and boost/json.hpp are counted as parser source; the other Boost headers it includes (System, Container, Core, Mp11, Endian and others) are compiled from the same archive but not counted.
